purpose: The map data AROUND the benchmark lot for the report's site-context maps (D-090-R936/R937): neighbouring tax lots and building footprints for the lot's bounding box + 400 ft, and named street centre lines for the lot's bounding box + 1,000 ft. Tests replay only; no network.
extends_note: The subject lot's per-BBL MapPLUTO geometry (used to size these windows and to draw the subject outline) and the three layers' service metadata are the base pack's already-recorded responses (byte-exact, URLs identical); this pack adds ONLY the three window data recordings. The replay helper and the harness entry point serve the base pack's responses for those URLs.
capture_method: one-time keyless HTTPS GET via the project's own connectors (M5-T154, ruling Y11); no key, account or email address; no owner-name or any personal field requested.
digest_algorithm: sha256 over the exact UTF-8 response bytes
capture_notes: Captured 2026-10-10. The MapPLUTO window out-fields are OBJECTID,BBL,Block,Lot,Address,Version ONLY (never OwnerName). Each connector also fetched its layer metadata (MapPLUTO/building/DCM); those responses are byte-identical to the base pack's (verified at capture) and are served from the base pack on replay, so this pack stores only the three window data recordings.

files.connector: app.connectors.mappluto_window_arcgis.build_window_query_url(envelope=(1048388.63, 215910.44, 1049311.58, 216831.1)) - the subject lot's EPSG:2263 bounding box (0.01 ft) padded by 400 ft
files.purpose: Neighbouring tax lots whose outline intersects the subject lot's bbox + 400 ft (201 features including the subject BBL 4073340070, which the connector excludes from the 200 neighbours).
Building footprints intersecting the subject lot's bbox + 400 ft (263 footprints, one page).
Street centre lines intersecting the subject lot's bbox + 1,000 ft (35 segments; named streets include Northern Boulevard '100', 215 Place '60', 215 Street '60').
